card.name: Partway through odd compound terms
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of a longer technical term, such as the 'aged' in paged-external-scheme, the 'but' in levalbuterol, and the 'ip' in phospholipidosis. Also fires on a few joining marks in lists.

modes.label: Inside drug and medical names
modes.description: The middle piece of a long drug or disease name, such as levalbuterol or phospholipidosis.

modes.label: Software configuration names
modes.description: Pieces inside hyphenated config element or constant names in technical documentation.

modes.label: Joiners in lists
modes.description: A comma, space or 'or' linking items in a list of doses or conditions.

card.writes: No clear theme; it seems to push toward word-continuation pieces and away from unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of long, unusual names, especially drug names like levalbuterol.
